title: Monaco west finite visible-surface polygons
status: Source-qualified surface-role reconstruction with declared approximate edges. Height planes, native field, road and protection are preserved. Fresh native visual review remains required.

source.source_use: Authoring observation only; no reference pixels are game textures.

transform.method: EPSG:3944 inverse Lambert conformal conic (GRS80; central meridian 3°, standard parallels 43.25°/44.75°, origin latitude 44°); resulting WGS84 transformed using CircuitScene.geo local tangent plane.

limits.digitized_edge_uncertainty_m: approximately ±1m; shadows, tree crowns and orthophoto parallax obscure some boundaries
limits.elevation: No elevations are assigned. IGN RGE points vary by measurement source; the sampled 2m grid does not imply 2m accuracy.
limits.layer: Upper white cap/path and all roofs/buildings are excluded; the white/paved appearance over BATIMENT0000000074074420 is an elevated roof/deck, not ground proof.
limits.usage: Do not flatten, extend contact, move walls, or assign terrain beneath the held L terraces from these polygons.

registration_checks.note: Visual pixel pick; agreement checks transform only, not source accuracy.
